thread:
maria.g: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — putting a compact action list in the thread so we can track owners/timelines. Main gaps: cloud provider region blips, model-registry auth flake, and third-party auth provider throttling. @kevin.h @daisy_lee @sam_ops please ack and add details.

kevin.h: Ack. I can own multi-region failover for the upload/ingest path. Plan: add cross-region DNS failover + healthcheck-based routing. ETA: 2 weeks for initial rollout, 4 weeks for full e2e test. Will create infra task and PR.

daisy_lee: I'll own model-registry fallback. Short-term: implement local pinned-cache of manifests + read-only fallback image registry. Medium-term: add auth token rotation & retry/backoff hooks in the registry client. ETA: cache + tests by 2026-04-10.

sam_ops: I'll handle vendor escalations and contract review for SLAs. Reaching out to our cloud account team today and asking for incident timeline + credit. Also opening a support case with auth provider about 429 patterns.

oncall-bot: Incident #2026-03-15-01 attached: https://incidents.internal/2026-03-15-01 :cloud-outage: (automated summary)

maria.g: Action items condensed (please copy to your boards):
1) Multi-region failover for upload service — owner: kevin.h — due: 2026-04-07
2) Model-registry fallback + cached manifests — owner: daisy_lee — due: 2026-04-10
3) Auth client retry/backoff + metrics — owner: daisy_lee — due: 2026-04-14
4) Vendor SLA follow-up + credits — owner: sam_ops — due: 2026-03-30
5) Add recurring incident pattern review cadence (biweekly) — owner: maria.g — start: 2026-03-29

kevin.h: Draft infra checklist I'm going to add to the PR:
```
- Add healthcheck endpoints for ingest workers
- Route A: primary region
- Route B: secondary region (cold) + failover policy TTL 30s
- Automate failback window & alerts to #incidents
```

daisy_lee: Example client-level retry config I'm proposing (will include in registry client):
```json
{"max_retries": 5, "base_backoff_ms": 200, "max_backoff_ms": 5000, "on_429": "exponential"}
```

sam_ops: Question for infra: if we add cross-region DNS failover do we need a separate VPC peering or will the cloud-managed LB handle it?

kevin.h: cloud-managed LB can handle cross-region routing but we'll want healthchecks in each region + route53 failover for the edge case where LB control plane is impacted. I'll document options in the infra ticket.

maria.g: Note on recurring patterns: this is the 3rd time in 6 months we've seen auth provider throttling correlate with high-regression rollout traffic. Proposal: add a pre-rollout checklist item to throttle rollout pace and enable canary routing for registry ops. Reasonable?

daisy_lee: Agree. Also adding a metric: 95th pct auth lat + 429 rate to the model-registry dashboard. That should give early warning.

sam_ops: I'll ask vendors for historical 429/latency metrics for the last 90 days. If they can't provide, we may push for SLA language.

oncall-bot: Reminder set by maria.g: recurring incident pattern review (biweekly) starting 2026-03-29 at 10:00 UTC.

maria.g: Cool — last ask: everyone please post PR/ticket links here when created. I'll collate into the postmortem follow-up doc and ping Execs on progress next week. :thumbsup:

kevin.h: Adding infra ticket now: https://tracker.internal/INFRA-8721

daisy_lee: Registry task created: https://tracker.internal/MLENG-3345 (cached manifests) and https://tracker.internal/MLENG-3346 (auth retries)

sam_ops: Vendor case: CASE-99321 opened with cloud provider; I'll paste updates here.

maria.g: Thanks all — closing the loop for now. We'll use the biweekly review to surface regressions and adjust owners if needed.
